name: Clamp Gripper

gripX.label: Grip width X (m)
gripX.desc: Gap between the jaws, which is the width of the pickup box. The orange dots on the tool drag it in the viewport, and they ride the arm.

gripY.label: Grip height Y (m)
gripY.desc: Height of the pickup box, centred on the box centre. A load whose centre is inside the box is picked.

gripZ.label: Grip depth Z (m)
gripZ.desc: Length of the jaws along the load, and the depth of the pickup box.

gripDepth.label: Box centre below flange (m)
gripDepth.desc: How far below the tool flange the centre of the pickup box sits. The jaws are as long as it takes to reach the box.
